storylines: GORD: We've been saying that. Now someone has to actually do it. CASEY: Next time out, I think they do. Slap Nuts coming to town — Friday, September 11th, 7:20 PM, home ice at Canlan, Rink 3. First meeting of the season, so we don't have tape on them yet, but the Village People have home ice, they've got something to prove after tonight, and I like the energy. GORD: "Slap Nuts." I will say this — that is a team name that, in a different era, would have had some consequences on the ice. In this league, I guess we'll just have to beat them with our feelings. CASEY: That's Ice & Easy. We'll see you Friday.
